title: PHArmacoKinetics of methYLphenidate in adult patients with ADHD: comparison between patients with and without OBesity_PHACYLOB.
official: PHArmacoKinetics of methYLphenidate in adult patients with ADHD: comparison between patients with and without OBesity_PHACYLOB.
summary: Main objective: Compare the total area under the curve of MPH and its active metabolite, alpha-phenyl 2-piperidine acid, between patients with ADHD and obesity and patients with ADHD but without obesity.
conditions: Attention Deficit Disorder with or without Hyperactivity (ADHD) is a neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by disabling symptoms of inattention and/or hyperactivity-impulsivity beginning before the age of 12 with significant personal, social, academic and/or occupational impact (American Psychiatric Association 2013). This disorder, whose prevalence is around 5% in children and adolescents, affects 2.6% of adults (American Psychiatric Association 2013; Song et al. 2021).

interventions.name: RITALINE L.P. 10 mg, gélule à libération prolongée

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age greater than or equal to 18 years
2. Diagnosis of ADHD by referring clinician, DSM-5 criteria (mixed form ADHD, predominantly inattentive or predominantly hyperactive/impulsive)
3. Treatment with Ritalin LP with stable dosage for at least two weeks
4. BMI inclusion criteria: (1) for obese group: BMI ≥ 30 kg/m2; (2) for non-obese group: BMI < 30 kg/m2
5. Participant affiliated to a social security scheme
6. Written consent signed by the participant
Exclusion criteria:
1. Contraindications to methylphenidate treatment (see pharmacological aspects below)
2. Patients under legal protection
3. Patient's inability to self-assess the intensity of ADHD symptoms
4. Treatment with an oral or nasal decongestant vasoconstrictor; association with a non-selective MAOI antidepressant
5. Treatment with a proton pump inhibitor within the last 2 weeks
6. Severe cognitive impairment (clinical evaluation)
7. Severe alcohol use disorder, i.e. at least 6 DSM-5 criteria for substance use disorder (clinical evaluation)
8. Current use of at least one illicit substance (e.g. cannabis, opiates, cocaine)
9. Known renal impairment documented in pre-treatment work-up (eDFG <30 ml/min/1.73m2)
10. Pregnant or breast-feeding women
11. Patient of childbearing age without at least one acceptable contraceptive method (see definition in appendix 1)
